name: TypeScript agent workflows
description: Persist LangGraph checkpoints and resume scripted agent steps and human approval flows from SQLite.

execution.network: No network access required by bundled workloads.
execution.smokeCommand: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import {StateGraph} from "@langchain/langgraph"; import {SqliteSaver} from "@langchain/langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite"; import {z} from "zod"; assert.equal(typeof StateGraph,"function"); assert.equal(z.number().parse(7),7); const saver=SqliteSaver.fromConnString(":memory:"); assert.equal(saver.db.prepare("SELECT 7 AS value").get().value,7); saver.db.close();' && node /opt/render/runtime/node-recipe.mjs smoke typescript-agent-workflows agent-checkpoint-workflow
